_doc: Shrink-only disclosed list of `gz validate` scopes that no registered enforcement claim names as its gate (GHI #1155). Seeded 2026-10-01 at the population measured on main: 100 scopes in VALIDATOR_REGISTRY, of which the entries below had no claim whose source_fn or gate_targets is a function the scope's runner delegates to. An entry records a DISCLOSED absence of a control, never a justified one: it means the count is visible and a load-bearing control is still owed. NEVER add an entry to silence a newly authored scope; register a claim instead (the laundering ADR-0.0.73 Boundary Invariant #8 forbids). An entry MUST be surrendered the moment a claim names its scope (gz validate --gate-enrollment fails closed on a stale acceptance), which is what makes the list shrink-only. Enforced by src/gzkit/governance/trust_audits/gate_enrollment.py and ratcheted via data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json. The population is validate scopes only; check steps that run a tool, precomplete checks, complete refusals and closeout steps are not yet enumerated.
